tooltip.tooltipText: Reduce the frequency and severity of lag and stutters.

Records timing information for freezes of 500 ms or longer. Keeps a small buffer in memory and writes to the mod log after combat. Enable while investigating freezes; works with Performance improvements on or off.
Displays a button to leave dungeon while in a dungeon and not in combat.
Adjusts the gameplay camera's field of view. 100% keeps the game's default, including its sprint effect.

Changes the appearance of damage numbers.

Blue: magic hit
Blue/pink: magic critical hit
Orange: physical hit
Orange/red: physical critical hit
White: raw hit
White/gold: raw critical hit
Green: heal
Gold/green: critical heal

configs.label: Show skill icons next to damage numbers

tooltip.tooltipText: Shows the responsible skill's icon beside floating damage and healing numbers, including received healing in the HUD feed. Works with or without Fancy damage numbers.
Hides floating damage and healing numbers, including incoming damage and healing numbers in the effects feed.

Shows equipped skills with active procs or special highlights near the character, with a rounded pulsing golden border. Timed procs show their remaining duration inside the icon. Using a highlighted skill gives its alert a brief black-and-white impact frame, a gold flash, an expanding frame and sparkles. Follows the game's skill highlight rules, including Aimed Shot and Pyroclasm.
Adds a thin black outline around buff and debuff stack numbers, such as Chaincast, to make them easier to read. Enabled by default.
Boss health bars will show the raw health value alongside percentage. Instead of just "100%", you will see "150,000 (100%)".
Makes Crabgantua's rockfall warnings visible through the flooding water attack
Hides health bars above allied minions. Your own summons' health bars remain visible.
Hides messages when friends connect or disconnect. Their online status still updates normally.

/box: Teleport to Navelin's Guild Merchant while on the same overworld map.
/invite <player>: Invite a player to your party.
/leave: Leave your party.
/w <player>: Open a whisper to a player. Add a message after their name to send it immediately.

Names are matched from your area, party, friends, or players seen in chat. Use quotes around names containing spaces.
Pressing Enter to send a message also closes the chat textbox, returning control of your character.
Add a private note of up to 30 characters from a friend's settings menu. Notes appear beside their name and are saved on this computer. Save an empty note to remove it.

configs.label: Wait for party to enter dungeon

tooltip.tooltipText: Prevents entering a dungeon solo while in a party.
Use a separate hotkey to open another player's interaction menu. Hold the selected key while looking at them. Loot, NPC interactions, and reviving allies keep the regular Interact button.
Show chat bubbles above your own character when you send a message.
Show local receipt time as [HH:MM] before chat messages. Existing system timestamps are kept. Updates messages already in chat.
